programs.name: sudmofk
programs.purpose: Apply log-stretch frequency-wavenumber dip-moveout correction to common-offset gathers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDMOFK - DMO via F-K domain (log-stretch) method for common-offset gathers

params.name: tdmo
params.description: Increasing times for the velocity function; must match vdmo in length.

params.name: fmax
params.default: computed: 0.5 divided by the first trace header dt in seconds

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable if set, otherwise empty string
params.description: Directory for temporary header storage; an empty value uses tmpfile().

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT ordering, cubic and sinc interpolation, log-stretch mappings, trigonometric functions, and accumulation across offsets affect rounding; header dt conversion uses double before assignment to float.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program combines offset mixing, log-stretch mapping, interpolation and multidimensional FFT-based DMO.

test_cases.description: Single common-offset gather with default velocity.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sushw key=offset a=200 | sudmofk cdpmin=1 cdpmax=16 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 > out.su
suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sushw key=offset a=300 | sudmofk cdpmin=1 cdpmax=16 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 tdmo=0,0.4 vdmo=1500,2000 sdmo=0.6 fmax=80 > out.su

programs.name: sudmofkcw
programs.purpose: Apply converted-wave log-stretch frequency-wavenumber dip-moveout correction to common-offset gathers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDMOFKCW - converted-wave DMO via F-K domain (log-stretch) method for

params.name: tdmo
params.description: Increasing times for the velocity function; must match vdmo in length.

params.name: flip
params.description: Reverse conversion-point shift and exchange stretch factors when nonzero.

params.name: fmax
params.default: computed: 0.5 divided by the first trace header dt in seconds

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT ordering, interpolated conversion-point tables, log-stretch mappings, trigonometric functions and offset accumulation affect rounding.
programs.difficulty_reason: Converted-wave DMO adds conversion-point tables and asymmetric stretching to a multi-trace FFT algorithm.

test_cases.description: Converted-wave DMO with default velocity ratio.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sushw key=offset a=200 | sudmofkcw cdpmin=1 cdpmax=16 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 > out.su

test_cases.description: Reverse the shift with a non-default velocity ratio and table size.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sushw key=offset a=300 | sudmofkcw cdpmin=1 cdpmax=16 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 gamma=0.7 ntable=200 flip=1 sdmo=0.6 fmax=80 > out.su

programs.name: sudmotivz
programs.purpose: Apply dip-moveout correction for vertically varying transversely isotropic media.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDMOTIVZ - DMO for Transeversely Isotropic V(Z) media for common-offset

params.name: fmax
params.default: computed: 0.5 divided by the first trace header dt in seconds

params.name: vnfile
params.description: Binary native-float NMO interval velocity samples; absent uses tdmo and vndmo.

params.name: etafile
params.description: Binary native-float interval eta samples; absent uses tdmo and etadmo.

params.name: vfile
params.description: Binary native-float interval velocity samples; absent uses vdmo or the NMO velocity function.

params.name: tdmo
params.description: Increasing times for supplied model arrays; read separately for each model without a file.

params.name: vndmo
params.description: NMO interval velocities; must match tdmo in length when vnfile is absent.

params.name: etadmo
params.description: Interval eta values; must match tdmo in length when etafile is absent. The selfdoc incorrectly states 1500.0.

params.name: vdmo
params.default: computed: copy the sampled NMO velocity function when its value count differs from tdmo
params.description: Interval velocities; used when vfile is absent and its value count matches tdmo.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ray tracing, iterative nonlinear mapping and linear solves, FFTs, interpolation, accumulated integrals and transcendental functions are sensitive to rounding and operation order. The anisotropic model adds further coupled calculations.
programs.difficulty_reason: Anisotropic ray tracing, iterative mapping, linear solves and FFT-based DMO make this a complex numerical program.

test_cases.description: Default isotropic model through the anisotropic implementation.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sushw key=offset a=200 | sudmotivz cdpmin=1 cdpmax=16 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 > out.su

test_cases.description: Time-varying anisotropic model and non-default controls.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sushw key=offset a=200 | sudmotivz cdpmin=1 cdpmax=16 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 tdmo=0,0.4 vndmo=1500,1800 vdmo=1450,1700 etadmo=0.1,0.15 speed=0.8 smute=2 fmax=80 > out.su

programs.name: sudmotx
programs.purpose: Apply Kirchhoff time-space dip-moveout correction to common-offset gathers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDMOTX - DMO via T-X domain (Kirchhoff) method for common-offset gathers

params.name: offmax
params.description: Maximum offset used to design the operator.

params.name: tmute
params.description: Mute time at offmax used to design the operator.

params.name: nsmax
params.description: Maximum number of DMO time shifts; accepted by code but omitted from selfdoc.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable if set, otherwise empty string
params.description: Directory for temporary header storage; an empty value uses tmpfile().

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Kirchhoff summation order, shaping-filter Toeplitz solve, convolution, and square-root and power calculations affect exact results.
programs.difficulty_reason: The Kirchhoff DMO operator requires multi-trace accumulation and construction of an anti-aliasing shaping filter.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sushw key=offset a=200 | sudmotx cdpmin=1 cdpmax=16 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 > out.su
suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sushw key=offset a=300 | sudmotx cdpmin=1 cdpmax=16 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 offmax=800 tmute=0.5 vrms=1800 nsmax=100 > out.su

params.name: fmax
params.default: computed: 0.5 divided by the first trace header dt in seconds

params.name: vfile
params.description: Binary native-float interval velocity samples; absent uses tdmo and vdmo.

params.name: tdmo
params.description: Increasing times for the interval velocity function; must match vdmo in length.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ray tracing, iterative nonlinear mapping and linear solves, FFTs, interpolation, accumulated integrals and transcendental functions are sensitive to rounding and operation order.
programs.difficulty_reason: Depth-variable DMO combines ray tracing and iterative numerical mapping with multi-trace FFT processing.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sushw key=offset a=200 | sudmovz cdpmin=1 cdpmax=16 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 > out.su
suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sushw key=offset a=200 | sudmovz cdpmin=1 cdpmax=16 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 tdmo=0,0.4 vdmo=1500,2000 speed=0.8 smute=2 fmax=80 > out.su

programs.name: sutihaledmo
programs.purpose: Apply one of several isotropic or anisotropic Hale-style dip-moveout operators to a single common-offset gather.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUTIHALEDMO - TI Hale Dip MoveOut (based on Hale's PhD thesis)

params.name: option
params.description: Operator selection: Hale, two Bleistein variants, Zhang, Tsvankin, or weak-anisotropy Tsvankin, numbered 1 through 6.

params.name: v
params.description: Velocity; must be positive for options 3 and 6.

params.name: file
params.description: ASCII vnmo-versus-ray-parameter file used by option 5; contains np, dp and np velocity values.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: The six operators use FFTs, complex arithmetic, summation and transcendental functions; results depend on operation order and math implementation. Input buffering stops only after nx exceeds nxmax, allowing one extra trace.
programs.difficulty_reason: Six frequency-wavenumber DMO formulations and disk-backed multidimensional buffering require substantial numerical and state handling.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sutihaledmo nxmax=16 option=1 dx=25 h=100 v=1500 > out.su
suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sutihaledmo nxmax=16 option=2 dx=25 h=100 ntpad=16 nxpad=4 > out.su
suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sutihaledmo nxmax=16 option=6 dx=25 h=100 v=1800 e=0.1 d=0.05 > out.su

programs.license_note: The author is identified as John E. Anderson, a visitor to CSM from Mobil; the header cites Anderson and Tsvankin's anisotropic DMO work.
